Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 5 weeks knee pain associated with ladder climbing.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion with synovitis. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Oblique undersurface tear of the body/posterior horn. Root attachments are intact. Minimal peripheral extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: Thinning of the femoral condyle articular cartilage, without focal defect. Tibial cartilage is maintained.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: High grade radial tear of the anterior horn/root. Small radial tearing at the posterior root. Minimal peripheral extrusion of the body segment.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Thinning of the femoral condyle articular cartilage, without focal defect. Tibial cartilage is maintained.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Low-grade chondrosis along the patellar medial facet and median ridge with foci of high-grade fissuring and small areas of subchondral cystic change/edema. Diffuse thinning of the trochlear cartilage, without focal defect.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Intact, with some degeneration of the proximal fibers.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. Borderline patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar and scattered subcutaneous edema about the knee. No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	High-grade radial tear of the lateral meniscal anterior horn/root. Small radial tearing at the lateral meniscal posterior root.
2.	Oblique undersurface tear of the medial meniscal body/posterior horn.
3.	Moderate patellofemoral chondrosis.
4.	Moderate knee effusion.

Unauffällig, keine muskuläre Atrophie.

Keine freien intraartikulären Gelenkkörper. 
Umschrieben subkutaner Erguss präpatellar sowie deutlich Erguss im Recessus suprapatellaris.

In Korrelation mit konventioneller Voruntersuchung 2 Skleroseinseln im Schienbein (4/19+16). Kein frischer Frakturnachweis. Kreuzbänder intakt. Kollateralbänder intakt. Menisci intakt. Keine höhergradige Chondropathie, keine osteochondrales Fragment. Kein Gelenkerguss. Quadrizepssehne intakt. Weichteile unauffällig.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Mild degenerative subchondral bone marrow edema and cystic changes are present at the medial tibial plateau. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation. No loose intra-articular bodies are seen. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: There is a large, complex tear involving the body and posterior horn, with a prominent horizontal component. Mild extrusion. A small flap fragment is displaced from the posterior horn toward the intercondylar notch.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning and fissuring diffusely.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild quadriceps tendinosis.
Patella tendon: Moderate patellar tendinosis with interstitial tearing distally.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 8 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Large, complex tear of the medial meniscus.

2. Chondrosis in the medial tibiofemoral compartment.

3. Quadriceps and patellar tendinosis with interstitial tearing at the distal patellar tendon.

4. Small joint effusion. Small, ruptured Baker cyst.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion with synovial thickening compatible with synovitis. There is popliteal cyst measuring 21 x 17 x 35 mm. Small amount of edema along the inferior margin of the popliteal cyst suggesting a minimal partial rupture.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
There is increased T2 hyperintense signal within the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending into the posterior horn-body junction without extension to the articular surface, compatible with intrasubstance degeneration. No frank tear.

Mild thickening of the proximal fibers of the medial cruciate ligament, with mild edema, compatible with grade 1 sprain. No frank tear.

Moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the weightbearing femur and tibia.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
There is a complex degenerative tear of the lateral meniscus with partial maceration of the anterior horn and anterior body, as well as a longitudinal oblique component involving the posterior horn. There is a 4 mm small displaced fragment along the lateral tibial gutter.

Full-thickness fissures in the articular cartilage of the tibial weightbearing surface with associated subchondral bone marrow edema. There is moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the weightbearing femur and of the tibial plateau. No subchondral bone marrow edema at the femur.

Mild increased signal intensity at the distal iliotibial band. The lateral collateral ligament complex is otherwise unremarkable.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
The anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are unremarkable. Mild early intraosseous cystic changes at the tibial insertion of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Multifocal deep and delaminating fissuring of the articular cartilage of the patellar facet without associated subchondral bone marrow edema. Additionally, there is moderate thinning of the articular cartilage of the femoral trochlea without subchondral bone marrow edema.
Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with mild edema in the suprapatellar fat pad.
Mild patellar tendinosis.

Bones:
Normal.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
Nonspecific edema in the anterior subcutaneous tissues along the infrapatellar region.

Small amount of fluid in the pes anserine bursa.

CONCLUSION:

- Tricompartmental moderate chondral thinning with deep fissures at the lateral and patellofemoral compartments, as described above.
- Complex degenerative tear of the lateral meniscus with tiny displaced fragment.
- Low-grade sprain of the medial collateral ligament.
- Small joint effusion with synovitis.
- Moderate-sized popliteal cyst with minimal partial rupture.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküste grade I dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kök yırtığı izlendi. Medial menisküs hafif ekstrüde izlendi.Medial kollateral ligamen çevresinde sıvı artışı izlenmiştir(grade I sprain).Ön çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal artışı izlendi. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellofemoral eklem medial faset düzeyinde komşu kıkırdak yapılarda bütünlük kaybı izlenmiştir(Artroz). Femur interkondiler düzey anteriorda yaklaşık 5x4 mm boyutta osteokondral defek izlendi.Suprapatellar bursada, medial reseste ,patellofemoral eklem düzeyinde ve tibiofemoral eklem düzeyinde sıvı artışları izlendi. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik sivrileşmeler izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde diz eklem aralığında daralma ve komşu kartilajlarda hafif incelmeler izlenmiştir(Dejeneratif artrit bulguları).
